{"code":"import bpy
import math
import random
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
import addon_utils
addon_utils.enable('object_cell_fracture', default_set=True, persistent=True)

ASSET_NAME = "glass_shatter_codex"
OUTPUT_DIR = f"/home/maz3ppa/projects/PlasmaDXR/build/vdb_output/{ASSET_NAME}"
RENDER_PATH = f"{OUTPUT_DIR}/{ASSET_NAME}.png"
BLEND_PATH = f"{OUTPUT_DIR}/{ASSET_NAME}.blend"
CACHE_DIR = f"{OUTPUT_DIR}/cache"

Path(OUTPUT_DIR).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
Path(CACHE_DIR).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

random.seed(17)

scene = bpy.context.scene
view_layer = bpy.context.view_layer

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cleanup
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if bpy.ops.object.mode_set.poll():
    bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')

bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete(use_global=False)

for mesh in list(bpy.data.meshes):
    if mesh.users == 0:
        bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh)
for material in list(bpy.data.materials):
    if material.users == 0:
        bpy.data.materials.remove(material)

def activate_object(obj):
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    obj.select_set(True)
    view_layer.objects.active = obj


def apply_scale(obj):
    activate_object(obj)
    bpy.ops.object.transform_apply(location=False, rotation=False, scale=True)


def assign_material(obj, mat):
    if obj.data.materials:
        obj.data.materials[0] = mat
    else:
        obj.data.materials.append(mat)


def look_at(obj, target):
    direction = Vector(target) - obj.location
    obj.rotation_euler = direction.to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()


def add_cube(name, location, scale, material=None, rotation=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)):
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1.0, location=location, rotation=rotation)
    obj = bpy.context.object
    obj.name = name
    obj.scale = scale
    if material is not None:
        assign_material(obj, material)
    return obj

def make_concrete_material(name, dark=False, floor=False):
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name=name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    links = mat.node_tree.links
    nodes.clear()

    out = nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
    out.location = (450, 0)
    bsdf = nodes.new('ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled')
    bsdf.location = (200, 0)

    texcoord = nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord')
    texcoord.location = (-900, 0)
    mapping = nodes.new('ShaderNodeMapping')
    mapping.location = (-700, 0)
    noise = nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
    noise.location = (-500, 100)
    noise.inputs['Scale'].default_value = 6.0 if floor else 8.0
    noise.inputs['Detail'].default_value = 10.0
    noise.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.55

    noise2 = nodes.new('ShaderNodeTexNoise')
    noise2.location = (-500, -150)
    noise2.inputs['Scale'].default_value = 18.0 if floor else 12.0
    noise2.inputs['Detail'].default_value = 6.0
    noise2.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.7

    ramp = nodes.new('ShaderNodeValToRGB')
    ramp.location = (-260, 110)
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].position = 0.25
    ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].position = 0.8
    if floor:
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[0].color = (0.08, 0.08, 0.085, 1.0)
        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (0.22, 0.22, 0.23, 1.0)

        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (0.3, 0.31, 0.33, 1.0)

        ramp.color_ramp.elements[1].color = (0.42, 0.43, 0.45, 1.0)

    bump = nodes.new('ShaderNodeBump')
    bump.location = (-40, -150)
    bump.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 0.18 if floor else 0.12
    bump.inputs['Distance'].default_value = 0.05

    links.new(texcoord.outputs['Object'], mapping.inputs['Vector'])
    links.new(mapping.outputs['Vector'], noise.inputs['Vector'])
    links.new(mapping.outputs['Vector'], noise2.inputs['Vector'])
    links.new(noise.outputs['Fac'], ramp.inputs['Fac'])
    links.new(noise2.outputs['Fac'], bump.inputs['Height'])
    links.new(ramp.outputs['Color'], bsdf.inputs['Base Color'])
    links.new(bump.outputs['Normal'], bsdf.inputs['Normal'])
    bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.88 if floor else 0.92
    bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = 0.0
    links.new(bsdf.outputs['BSDF'], out.inputs['Surface'])
    return mat
